intro.label: About us
intro.heading: Professional event staffing – tailored to your occasion
intro.text1: A successful event is about more than décor and guest lists. It's about flow, atmosphere, and execution. It's about everything working — without you noticing.
intro.text2: BarPro delivers complete, professional event staffing for weddings, private celebrations, and corporate events. We adapt to your needs and develop solutions that suit the occasion, whether you want a classic and refined look or a more creative and energetic profile.
intro.text3: We provide experienced bartenders and service staff, and create drink menus tailored to your wishes. Signature drinks, themed menus, or timeless classics — we ensure the expression, quality, and details match the level of the rest of your event.
intro.text4: Our strength lies in the combination of structure and presence. We work precisely, efficiently, and discreetly, so you can focus on the guests and the experience.

story.text1: BarPro was founded by Emil and Sofie with a simple vision: to deliver premium bartender and event staffing that exceeds expectations. With backgrounds from some of Norway's best venues and events, we saw a need for professional bar service that could adapt to any occasion.
story.text2: Today, we are proud to offer tailored solutions for weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations in Innlandet and all of Norway. Every event we take on is treated with the same dedication and attention to detail.

emil.name: Emil
emil.bio: Most people in Innlandet have probably had a drink from Emil at least once — whether they remember it or not. With years of experience as a bartender, he brings creativity and expertise to every event.

sofie.name: Sofie
sofie.bio: Sofie has a natural talent for reading the room and making every guest feel seen. With an eye for detail and infectious energy behind the bar, she elevates any event.

intro.title: About this policy
intro.text: BarPro takes your privacy seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with the Norwegian Personal Data Act and GDPR.

whatWeCollect.title: What we collect
whatWeCollect.text: When you submit a request or book through our website, we collect: name, email address, phone number (optional), event type, number of guests, preferred date, and any messages you write to us.

whyWeCollect.title: Why we collect data
whyWeCollect.text: We use your information solely to process your request, prepare offers, deliver agreed services, and communicate with you about the event. We do not use your data for marketing unless you give explicit consent.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.text: Your data is securely stored with our data provider (Supabase) with encrypted transfer and access control. We retain data as long as necessary to fulfill its purpose, and delete it within 12 months after the event is completed, unless legal requirements dictate otherwise.

sharing.title: Third-party sharing
sharing.text: We do not share your personal data with third parties, except for technical service providers necessary for operating the service (email provider, database host). These are subject to data processing agreements.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, correct, delete, and port your data. You can withdraw your consent at any time. Contact us at Barproda@gmail.com to exercise your rights. We respond within 30 days.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We only use necessary cookies for the website to function (authentication, language selection). We do not use third-party tracking cookies or analytics tools that collect personal data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: The data controller is BarPro. For privacy questions, contact us at Barproda@gmail.com.

whatIncluded.a: All packages include professional bartenders, bar, glassware, ice, setup and takedown. Beverages and ingredients are supplied by the client — we're happy to help with recommendations and shopping lists.

alcohol.q: Do we need a serving license?
alcohol.a: For private events where guests aren't paying for drinks, a serving license is typically not required. We provide guidance tailored to your event.

howFar.a: We cover Innlandet and gladly take on events across Norway. Travel costs apply for events outside Innlandet.

howBook.a: Send us a request through the contact form or reach out directly. We respond within 24 hours with a no-obligation quote.

cancel.a: We have flexible cancellation terms. Full refund for cancellations more than 30 days before the event. Contact us for full terms.

nonAlcoholic.a: Absolutely. We happily create a complete non-alcoholic drink menu with signature drinks that are just as thoughtful and delicious as the alcoholic ones.

welcome.title: Welcome to BarPro — we're ready for your next celebration
welcome.p1: We're Emil and Sofie, and together we started BarPro with one clear ambition: to deliver bartender and event staffing that truly makes a difference for your event.
welcome.p2: After years behind the bar at everything from weddings and birthdays to corporate events and festivals, we saw a need in Innlandet for something more than just 'a bartender'. We wanted to offer a complete experience — from the first conversation to the last glass cleared away.
welcome.p3: With us, you get experienced bartenders who know their craft, custom drink menus tailored to your occasion, and all the equipment you need. We bring the bar, glassware and ice — you provide the drinks and the guests.
welcome.p4: Whether you're planning an intimate gathering for 20 or a grand wedding for 200, we adapt to your needs. We believe the best parties happen when the host can relax and enjoy the evening — and that's where we come in.
welcome.p5: We look forward to getting to know you and your event. Get in touch for a no-obligation chat, and we'll figure out how to make your next celebration something truly special.

footer.tagline: Professional event staffing for unforgettable experiences
